title: Moderation
intro: Reported messages, accounts, profiles, media and reviews. Critical cases are at the top, oldest first within each priority.
restricted: Cases contain private messages. They are for moderation and Trust & Safety; support has no access.

NO_ACTION.default: The case is dismissed. Content blocked immediately becomes visible again.

CHANGES_REQUESTED.default: The media goes back to the provider for changes, with your reason.

CONTENT_REMOVED.default: The content is no longer visible afterwards.
CONTENT_REMOVED.MESSAGE: Both sides see the message as “Hidden by moderation”.
CONTENT_REMOVED.PROFILE: The profile is no longer public afterwards.
CONTENT_REMOVED.MEDIA: The media is blocked; the provider sees it in the studio with your reason.
CONTENT_REMOVED.REVIEW: The review disappears from the profile.
CONTENT_REMOVED.ORGANIZATION: The organisation is no longer public afterwards.

ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED.default: The account behind the content can no longer send messages or appointment requests.

ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.default: The account can no longer sign in, all sessions end, a provider profile is no longer public.

rules.R-MOD-2: Fraud, spam or deception about services and prices
rules.R-MOD-3: False identity or someone else’s pictures
rules.R-MOD-5: Suspected coercion, exploitation or human trafficking

decision.title: Decision
decision.criticalText: Only Trust & Safety decides critical cases. You see the case so it does not get stuck.
decision.ruleHint: “No violation” only goes with R-MOD-0, every measure with a rule R-MOD-1 to 8.

kindHint.MESSAGING: No messages and no new conversations.
kindHint.BOOKING: No appointment requests; accepting and counter-proposals are blocked, cancelling is not.

decision.untilHint: Format DD.MM.YYYY, valid until 23:59. Without an end the measure applies until someone lifts it.
decision.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is in the audit log; for a measure the affected person sees it too.

appeal.ownTitle: Someone else decides on this appeal
appeal.ownText: You decided the case. A second person reviews the appeal.

case.UPHELD: A measure is reversed: content visible again, restrictions of the case lifted. Against “No violation” the case opens again.
case.DISMISSED: The decision stays as it is.

restriction.DISMISSED: The restriction stays until its end.

appealDecision.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is in the audit log.
